scope: Initial read-only source discovery and access checks, followed by a separate collector and independent full-row audit of the official Eurostat alternative. This record does not claim the UN file was obtained.

sources.coverage_from_primary_search_metadata: 1990–2024; 233 countries and areas; 60 fully reassessed for the 2024 edition, with the remaining estimates extrapolated from the 2020 edition.
sources.limitation: The file was not read. Do not represent its bilateral rows as collected or verified. No proxy, origin substitution, special-header retry or access-control workaround was attempted.

sources.dataset: migr_pop3ctb — Population on 1 January by age group, sex and country of birth
sources.access: Official Data Browser landing resolves but its client-rendered table is not exposed to the web reader. The official catalogue/search metadata describes annual coverage from 1998 to 2025.
sources.intended_dimensions: Reporting destination × country of birth, with total age and sex selected once.
limitations: European reporting destinations, not a global bilateral matrix.
Country of birth must not be substituted with citizenship without recording the concept change.
Age/sex totals must not be added to their component rows.
Availability, suppressed values and reporting breaks must be audited after extraction.
sources.subsequent_collection: A separate collector obtained five official API slices for DE/ES/FR/IT/NL, 2005–2025, age TOTAL, sex T, unit NR.
sources.collected_scope_limit: Individual-origin data are absent in the selected DE slice; ES/FR coverage is sparse. The successful alternative does not supply a global bilateral matrix.

sources.dataset: Database on Immigrants in OECD and non-OECD Countries (DIOC)
sources.independent_locator: About and DIOC sections, including Reference years 2020/21.
sources.coverage_from_primary_landing: 34 destination countries and more than 200 origins; 2020/21 full dataset is marked provisional. Earlier census reference rounds are listed separately.
limitations: Census reference rounds are not an annual migration-stock time series.
File-specific coverage, age filters, coding and weights still require extraction and verification.
DIOC-E lists broader destination coverage but older reference rounds; it is not interchangeable with provisional DIOC 2020/21.

model_limitations: A bilateral migrant stock is a candidate explanatory factor, not observed passenger journeys or visiting-friends-and-relatives trip frequency.
Country-level migrant stock requires an explicit allocation assumption before it can support a city-pair forecast.
A newer census release cannot be used as information available in an earlier backtest origin without a stated retrospective-data limitation.
Any additional predictive value must be evaluated against a traffic-only baseline on held-out periods and routes.
